summary: Situated in the heart of Eastbourne, this delightful two bedroom semi-detached property offers the perfect blend of comfort and convenience.
description:
LOUNGE Good sized lounge with bay window providing plenty of natural light.

KITCHEN Rear aspect kitchen requiring updating with direct access to the garden via UPVC door.

BEDROOM Spacious main bedroom overlooking the front, with bay window.

BEDROOM Second double bedroom positioned at the rear aspect.

BATHROOM Family bathroom comprising bath with overhead shower and glass screen with sink basin, the toilet is located separately.

EXTERNALLY The property benefits from a good sized, fence enclosed front garden with access to the rear via the side.
